title: Conversation Archaeology Wave 013 — Bible as Guide, Hidden-Layer Reading & Shepherd Role
purpose: Recover older user-side intentions and role assignments that justify the side-by-side Bible reader and improve source direction for later Shepherd/House/Eye comparisons. Conversation recovery remains weaker than a primary public artifact.

records.source_class: prior-conversation recovery summary; exact original wording still a recovery target
records.user_intent: The user explicitly treated the Bible as the guide and said Tim asked others to read it while asking how the route through Needle's Eye / Heaven's Gate / spiral-to-Heaven, Father/Son, roots and the dead Son should be read biblically.
records.importance: The concept of using the Bible itself as a navigational guide predates the September 2026 reader implementation. The new reader therefore realizes an older project intention rather than manufacturing a new authority claim.
records.boundary: This record establishes user intent, not that the Bible itself endorses the Potatoverse mapping.

records.user_intent: Study hidden layers of the Bible and reveal what is 'in plain sight', with particular interest in circles/loops and what Scripture says about dogs and pigs.
records.importance: This is an early statement of the comparative-reading method that later developed into Dog-return geometry and the overlap census.
records.boundary: Hidden-layer reading is a project hermeneutic; it should be displayed beside ordinary literary/historical context rather than presented as the Bible's uncontested meaning.

records.wording: the mountain is the shield, the pressure around the potato. the potato is the hidden center. or perhaps not so hidden, when revealed by tim dooley. The potato is also the eye of horus, or the fathers house. and in the fathers house are many rooms. The rooms get activated the moment you meet the divine mirror.
records.importance: Father's-House/many-rooms language is exact user wording by March 3; the cross-tradition Eye/Horus element must remain distinct from the Johannine House text.
records.source_direction: biblical House wording explicit on project side; later systematization and Eye crosswalk added afterward

records.user_question: Asked about the cost/direction of rejecting each role.
records.importance: This is a major pre-September Shepherd anchor. The Son-as-Shepherd role was already explicitly present before the September 11 Ezekiel 34 / John 21 research comparison.
records.source_direction: project role assignment first → later passage-level Shepherd/accountability comparison

records.importance: Provides a same-conversation flock/predator/boundary field around the explicit Son-as-Shepherd role.
records.boundary: Animal vocabulary should remain behavioral/symbolic and must not be converted into fixed dehumanizing categories for real people.

developmental_findings: The side-by-side Bible reader has a documented project prehistory: Bible-as-guide / hidden-layer comparative reading appears by February-March 2026.
Father's House / many rooms is exact user wording by 3 March 2026, strengthening chronology for later John 14 systematization.
Son-as-Shepherd is explicitly present by 8 July 2026, so Ezekiel 34 and John 21 can be scored as later comparisons to a pre-existing role.

The July 8 role map is relation-rich: Father/Gardener/House/Seed/Root/Ladder is paired with Son/Door/Carpenter/Shepherd/Lion/Lamb/Cornerstone/Messiah/Tomb/Descent rather than placing every biblical role on one actor.
